title: Understanding the bidirectional associations between parenting and child anxiety
abstract: Nature Reviews Psychology, Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44159-026-00618-2 Associations between parent characteristics and child characteristics must be considered to mitigate the impacts of child anxiety. In this Review, Yap et al. synthesize evidence about the directionality of influence between parents and children in the development and maintenance of child anxiety, highlighting implications for intervention and the efficacy of current approaches.
